items.title: MSD’s Lipfendra takes on injectable rivals for cholesterol-lowering market supremacy
items.summary: Armed with oral administration and a cheaper price tag, Lipfendra is touted as a major advancement for patients.

items.title: AusperBio raises $120m to progress hepatitis B therapies
items.summary: AusperBio Therapeutics and Ausper Biopharma have closed a Series C funding round worth $120m to support the development of new therapies for chronic hepatitis B.

items.title: FDA to review Kowa Pharmaceuticals’ NDA for glaucoma eye drop K-911
items.summary: The US FDA is set to review Kowa Pharmaceuticals America’s NDA for K-911, an investigational once-daily eye drop aimed at IOP in OAG or OHT patients.

items.title: SK inks $795m Biohaven epilepsy deal, entering potassium channel opener race
items.summary: SK and Biohaven hope opakalim will show differential benefit to Xenon’s rival focal epilepsy drug, azetukalner, in an upcoming pivotal readout.

items.title: ESC 2026: True impact of poor medicine adherence laid bare in hypertensive patients
items.summary: Study shows that those with low adherence of blood pressure-lowering drugs had significantly impaired therapeutic effect.
